concept.title: Ethernet Switch (Optional)
concept.shortdesc: An Ethernet switch expands the number of wired network connections available in a home network. It enables additional devices to connect to the network through Ethernet cables.

section.title: Overview
section.p: An Ethernet switch is a networking device that provides additional Ethernet ports for wired devices.
A switch is typically used when all available LAN ports on the are already in use.

section.title: Role of an Ethernet Switch
section.p: An Ethernet switch enables multiple wired devices to connect to the same network.
The switch receives network traffic from the and forwards the traffic to the appropriate connected device.
Devices connected through a switch can communicate with other devices on the network and access Internet services.

section.title: When to Use an Ethernet Switch
section.p: An Ethernet switch can be useful when the number of wired devices exceeds the available LAN ports on the router.
